svg.title: Bug 02: urfave/cli, merged
svg.desc: Upstream contribution to urfave/cli pull request 2460: Fix a GenericFlag panic with payload getters. Live status: merged. Boss: flag panic. The flag-carrying beetle is stomped flat and pops into sparks, its pennant stays planted and flying, and a coin drops. The boss's HP is empty.

g.text: FIX A GENERICFLAG PANIC WITH PAYLOAD GETTERS
